response.rationale: The order is still in transit and has not been delivered (days_since_delivery is null), so the return window governed by RET-007/RET-008 has not yet begun. No standard-window rule can currently establish eligibility since delivery has not occurred. Higher-priority exceptions do not apply: not final_sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051). A return cannot be processed until the item is delivered.
